verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at grafana.com/api/openapi.json, and the observability-as-code docs describe defining dashboards and data sources in code and automating admin tasks from the terminal and CI/CD. This points to a programmatic surface, but the pack has no first-party documentation describing the public HTTP API itself: its endpoints, authentication or coverage of product functions. missing for 10: explicit HTTP API reference documentation (endpoints, auth tokens, scope of operations), confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers the Grafana product rather than only grafana.com, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Grafana via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://grafana.com/api/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
You can authenticate, manage multiple environments, and perform administrative tasks from the terminal.
This approach lets you define dashboards, data sources, and other configurations in code, enabling version control, automated testing, and reliable deployments through CI/CD pipelines.
